scope: Evidence coverage review only; not final acceptance, risk closure, production extrapolation or G-RUNTIME.02 authorization

conditions.notes: Real separated databases and restricted service/Cell credentials are observed. The owners are laboratory fixtures, not every owning Business Service in an integrated Dedicated Managed deployment.
Actual role memberships, migration/runtime separation, DDL denials and default-grant observations support least privilege; migration impersonation is not proof of migration-password authentication.
Non-owner/non-superuser/non-bypass runtime roles and denied escalation/RLS-bypass attempts are evidenced. This does not contain a true superuser or hostile administrator (GS-01).
Real read/write RLS and spoof rejection are observed with separate synthetic logins. Production shared-runtime-credential principal-to-membership binding and Java/RLS integration are not established.

Laboratory Agent/Controller/executor credentials are segregated and scoped negatives exist. Real credential custody/delivery and approved Agent capability boundaries remain dependent on IAM/secrets decisions.

PostgreSQL and secured pool paths were exercised, but raw Hikari SESSION-GUC leakage remains FAIL, and fixture login binding is not product integration. This mandatory obligation is not closed by 14/0/0.
Documentary coverage: OD-012/013/014 remain open and no production topology is selected. This is not an executed runtime test or disposition of those decisions.

The original wording restricts the Reference Environment to one synthetic Tenant/one Dedicated Cell; later adversarial laboratories intentionally use two Tenants/multiple Cells. They test isolation but do not demonstrate that literal original topology. No waiver or amended condition is inferred.
Container/service/identity/network segregation is observed in the scoped laboratories, not complete profile deployment or hostile-host isolation.

Scoped runtime containment and absent runtime Docker sockets are observed; host orchestration remains a trusted administrative harness. Unrestricted-host/operator containment is explicitly not established (GS-01).
O-REF has separate Controller and Agent, unlike an Agent-only test double. Coverage is limited to two harmless adapters, not complete production management/lifecycle capabilities.
Scoped database/credential isolation is evidenced; full CL-004 lifecycle and custody dependencies are unresolved.
Real disposable network, readiness/startup, restart, recovery and owned cleanup observations exist. They are not a complete separately deployed profile's management-path lifecycle acceptance.
Distinct Controller/Agent/executor identities and independent authorization/execution decisions have positive and negative laboratory evidence.
Admission is not final authority: executor/owner rechecks and deterministic before-mutation barriers tie denial to unchanged effects.
Signed commands/grants, immutable operation identity, parameter/digest/target/version binding and substitution negatives support the scoped reference requirement.
Default-deny operation/resource/configuration validation is observed for LAB_MARKER_CAS and LAB_CONFIG_STAGE; X only permits LAB_MARKER_CAS. No arbitrary adapter coverage is claimed.
Injection denials and runtime capability/secret restrictions exist, but broader Agent/executor deployment privileges and adversarial host capabilities are not independently accepted.

Real PostgreSQL durable idempotency, concurrency/conflicts, process crash/WAL observations and interrupted reconciliation evidence cover the harmless laboratory operations; no universal recovery guarantee.
Fail-closed denials and explicit UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE outcomes are backed by state/effect evidence, not interpreted as operational success.

Separate real mTLS/durable execution laboratories exist. Production trust/bootstrap, approved privilege model and arbitrary adapter recovery remain outside the evidence; no closure of this mandatory verification obligation.
Fresh scoped synthetic credentials are evidenced, not real service-account issuance/custody/delivery for all owning services.
Actual runtime/migration privilege separation and denied escalation exist; trusted bootstrap administration is distinct from runtime authorization.
Private scratch/per-node key isolation and cleanup are observed. This does not prove production Secret Material storage, delivery, renewal, audit or leak prevention.
mTLS client/server rotation and reconnect/session controls are real; DB14 revocation is not the full database replacement-credential rotation/cleanup phase matrix under concurrent reconnect.
Emergency-style laboratory revocation can precede replacement. Complete database/IAM emergency containment and replacement-unavailable workflow are not established as one approved lifecycle.

Database old-session survival and targeted termination, secured pool cleanup and TLS session/resumption rejection are distinct observations. Raw pool leakage and product pool/session integration remain unresolved.
Partial lifecycle phases remain INCOMPLETE/UNKNOWN; revoked/stale restored state cannot activate the tested fixtures. No blind replay is inferred from transport loss.
Real database and TLS lifecycle evidence exists separately; approved production database credential lifecycle/custody and integrated sessions/pools are not proven. Mandatory obligation remains open.
Signed holder-bound synthetic identity and anti-spoof paths are observed. This is not approved production IdP/shared-credential principal-to-membership binding.
Semantic placement authority, deployment/Cell/lifecycle/generation binding and handoff observations exist for the reference trust model.
Tampering, wrong semantic authority, stale/expired/equal-version conflict and restart rollback negatives are supported by signed/state evidence.
Wrong profile/deployment, disabled/unavailable targets and unacknowledged/quarantined activation are denied; reconstruction alone cannot authorize activation.
Authenticated destination challenge in R and real PKIX/SAN/EKU/mTLS in W/DR/X distinguish peer identity from simple reachability; laboratory issuers remain trusted fixtures.
Independent forwarding journals and destination effects support no unauthorized forwarding/fallback after Router denial; authorized test traffic is not confused with zero traffic.
Four independently versioned authorities and final owner decisions compose without a synthesized global authority revision in X; host-driver anchors are still trusted.

Positive/negative real routing observations exist and were separately scoped, but final profile-wide authorization/trust/freshness integration is not established by laboratory counts. Mandatory obligation remains open.
Online context validation and outage denial are observed; no authorized bounded-local-state continuation path was exercised.
Placement semantic provenance is checked and cached allows cannot authorize new work during outage. Prior validation for an approved continuation policy is not evidenced.
Signed state, independent monotonic anchors and restore substitution checks exist; protected retained state under the unapproved offline policy/host threat model is not proven.
Known stale/conflicting generations are rejected in online/recovery paths. That does not prove an authorized offline continuation implementation.

Real grant expiry and laboratory clock/validity negatives exist; no approved operation-specific freshness, clock/restart or unobserved-revocation exposure policy is established. Lab 120 seconds is not a production SLA.
Known revocation/suspension is enforced in laboratory paths, not an authorized continuation model; unobserved revocation during outage remains unresolved.
Online/recovery target identity negatives are observed; no permitted offline target validation path is demonstrated.
Destination trust is real within the scoped lab issuer model, but no offline trust/revocation policy or continuation grant is approved.
Completed-result reconstruction is not continuation or reexecution of previously authorized operations. Outage refusal does not demonstrate bounded continuation eligibility.

No separately approved operation-specific continuation policy was located in the authoritative records. TI-14 remains DESIGN PARTIAL; actual continuation is prohibited. No NOT_APPLICABLE exemption is inferred.

negativeCases.notes: Bidirectional real RLS/owner denials and unchanged-state controls exist. Shared production credential binding and product end-to-end read/write authorization are not established.
Spoofed GUC/header/signed-context substitutions fail in the laboratories. Real IAM-to-product Tenant Context trust is not established.
Wrong Cell/deployment and direct-route negatives have authenticated destination and independent forwarding/effect observations within the reference scope.
Semantic wrong authority, stale/conflicting generations, handoff and before-effect fencing evidence exists; no global freshness guarantee follows.
Ordinary runtime escalation/SET ROLE/bypass attempts are denied. This is not proof that true SUPERUSER/BYPASSRLS or hostile host/admin authority is contained; GS-01 is preserved.
Secured private pool path PASS and raw Hikari SESSION-GUC leakage FAIL are both retained, not contradictory same-scope results. TLS resumption/session tests are not JDBC pool repair.
Database/mTLS scoped credentials reject cross-boundary use. Real IAM enrollment, delivery and lifecycle across all product services remain unverified.

Real TLS-invalid dates, revocation/reconnect/resumption and operation fences exist under a synthetic issuer. Production identity authority/revocation distribution and exposure windows remain dependencies.
Default deny, independent executor authorization, injection negatives and zero adapter/effect evidence cover only the explicitly allowed harmless laboratory adapters.
Durable command identity, real crashes, revoked/stale replay rejection and recorded-result retries are observed; lost ACK remains UNKNOWN until reconciliation.
Outage/missing/conflicting authority denies forwarding/effects; incomplete ACK does not become completed authorization or offline permission.

negativeCases.originalIdentifier: Incorrect recovery or restoration into another Cell
negativeCases.notes: Tenant/Cell/digest/incarnation/grant substitution and quarantine/activation negatives are evidenced. General business recovery, hostile-anchor rollback and production RTO/RPO are excluded.
